'''Kasparas Jakučionis''' (born 29 May 2006) is a Lithuanian professional [[basketball]] player for the [[Milwaukee Bucks]] of the [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA). He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Illinois Fighting Illini men's basketball|Illinois Fighting Illini]].

==Early life and youth career==
Jakučionis was born in [[Vilnius]] and started playing basketball in the youth ranks of [[BC Rytas-2|Perlas Vilnius]], a team affiliated with [[Rytas Vilnius]]. In 2021, Jakučionis joined the youth ranks of [[FC Barcelona Bàsquet|FC Barcelona]]. In the 2022–23 season, Jakučionis alternated between Barcelona's junior team and the club's [[FC Barcelona Bàsquet B|reserve team]] in [[Liga EBA]]. Jakučionis would be selected to the 2023–24 [[Euroleague Basketball Next Generation Tournament|under-18 Euroleague]] All-Tournament Team.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.mundodeportivo.com/baloncesto/euroliga/20240526/1002253885/azulgrana-jakuciones-quinteto-ideal-angt.html |title=El azulgrana Jakucionis, en el quinteto ideal del ANGT |website=Mundo Deportivo |access-date=19 January 2025 |language=es |date=26 May 2024}}</ref> He would also make his professional debut for the FC Barcelona first team in April 2023, in a [[Liga ACB]] game against [[Coviran Granada]]. Upon his debut, he became the third youngest player to play for FC Barcelona in Liga ACB.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.cat/ca/noticies/3208431/kasparas-jakucionis-el-tercer-debutant-mes-jove-del-barca-a-lacb |title=Kasparas Jakucionis, el tercer debutant més jove del Barça a l'ACB |website=FC Barcelona |access-date=19 January 2025 |language=ca |date=19 April 2023}}</ref> On 12 January 2024, Jakučionis debuted in the [[EuroLeague]] in a game against [[BC Žalgiris|Žalgiris Kaunas]] and scored two points.<ref>{{cite web |title=FC Barcelona vs Zalgiris Kaunas (2024-01-12) |url=https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/euroleague/game-center/2023-24/fc-barcelona-zalgiris-kaunas/E2023/187/#box-score |website=[[Euroleague Basketball]] |date=22 December 2023 |access-date=19 November 2025}}</ref>

===Recruiting===
On 28 May 2024, Jakučionis committed to play [[college basketball]] for [[Illinois Fighting Illini men's basketball|Illinois]] under [[Brad Underwood]].<ref name="espn">{{cite web |last=Givony |first=Jonathan |title=Source: Lithuania's Kasparas Jakucionis commits to Illinois |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/40233577 |website=[[ESPN.com]] |access-date=28 May 2024 |date=28 May 2024}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Illinois Signs Jakucionis|url=https://fightingillini.com/news/2024/5/29/mens-basketball-illinois-signs-jakucionis.aspx|website=fightingillini.com|access-date=20 January 2025|date=29 May 2024}}</ref> FC Barcelona retained the player's rights upon a possible return to Europe.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.sport.es/es/noticias/barca/baloncesto/jakucionis-marcha-barca-busca-sueno-103024352 |title=Jakucionis se marcha del Barça en busca del 'sueño americano' |website=Sport.es |access-date=19 January 2025 |language=es |date=28 May 2024}}</ref>

==College career==
Jakučionis made his college basketball debut on 4 November 2024, recording 11 points, seven assists and five rebounds in 26 minutes in a win over [[2024–25 Eastern Illinois Panthers men's basketball team|Eastern Illinois]], setting a record for the most assists in a season-opener by a freshman.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |last=Erik |first=Hall |date=20 March 2025 |title=Kasparas Jakucionis: 3 things to know about the Illinois Fighting Illini basketball guard |url=https://www.thetelegraph.com/sports/article/kasparas-jakucionis-facts-illinois-basketball-32-20227147.php |access-date=8 July 2025 |website=[[The Telegraph (Alton, Illinois)|The Telegraph]]}}</ref> Four days later, in his second game, he set a new record with 13 assists against [[2024–25 SIU Edwardsville Cougars men's basketball team|SIU Edwardsville]],<ref name=":0"/> while also logging his first collegiate [[double-double]] with 12 points.<ref>{{Cite web |date=9 November 2024 |title='He plays to win': Jakucionis shows off NBA potential for Illini |url=https://www.thechampaignroom.com/2024/11/9/24291923/he-just-doesnt-force-anything-jakcuionis-impresses-in-second-collegiate-game-kasparas-underwood-brad |access-date=8 July 2025 |website=The Champaign Room}}</ref> On December 16, Jakučionis earned [[Big Ten]] Freshman of the Week honors (alongside [[Dylan Harper]]) after scoring at least 20 points in five consecutive games and leading the team in scoring.<ref>{{Cite web |date=16 December 2024 |title=Jakucionis B1G Freshman of the Week |url=https://fightingillini.com/news/2024/12/16/mens-basketball-jakucionis-b1g-freshman-of-the-week.aspx |access-date=8 July 2025 |website=University of Illinois Athletics}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |date=16 December 2024 |title=Jakucionis named Big Ten Freshman of the Week |url=https://www.wcia.com/sports/your-illini-nation/jakucionis-named-big-ten-freshman-of-the-week/ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250102151140/https://www.wcia.com/sports/your-illini-nation/jakucionis-named-big-ten-freshman-of-the-week/ |archive-date=2 January 2025 |access-date=8 July 2025 |work=WCIA.com |url-status=live}}</ref> On 6 January 2025, he was named Big Ten Freshman of the Week for the second time (alongside [[Ace Bailey (basketball)|Ace Bailey]] and [[Braden Smith (basketball)|Braden Smith]]) after leading the [[Illinois Fighting Illini men's basketball|Fighting Illini]] to a 3–0 week, averaging a team-best 16 points per game.<ref>{{Cite web |date=6 January 2025 |title=Jakucionis Earns Second B1G Freshman of the Week Honor |url=https://fightingillini.com/news/2025/1/6/mens-basketball-jakucionis-earns-second-b1g-freshman-of-the-week-honor.aspx |access-date=8 July 2025 |website=University of Illinois Athletics}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Purdue, Illinois, Rutgers Score Men's Basketball Weekly Accolades |url=https://bigten.org/mbb/article/blt08ad80dff76d3319/ |access-date=8 July 2025 |website=[[Big Ten Conference]]}}</ref>

At the conclusion of his freshman season, Jakučionis was named to the Big Ten All-Freshman Team and earned second-team [[List of All-Big Ten Conference men's basketball teams|All-Big Ten]] honors. On 14 April, he declared for the [[2025 NBA draft]], foregoing his remaining college eligibility.<ref>{{Cite magazine |date=14 April 2025 |title=Illinois Freshman Star Kasparas Jakucionis Declares for NBA Draft |url=https://www.si.com/college/illinois/basketball/illini-kasparas-jakucionis-enters-2025-nba-draft |access-date=8 July 2025 |magazine=[[Sports Illustrated]]}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=14 April 2025 |title=Illini star freshman Jakucionis to enter NBA draft |url=https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/44669227 |access-date=8 July 2025 |website=[[ESPN.com]]|last=Givony|first=Jonathan}}</ref>

==Professional career==

===Miami Heat (2025–2026)===
On 25 June 2025, Jakučionis was selected by the [[Miami Heat]] with the 20th overall pick in the 2025 NBA draft.<ref>{{cite web |last=Chiang |first=Anthony |title=Heat keeps pick to select Illinois guard Kasparas Jakucionis at No. 20 in NBA Draft |url=https://www.miamiherald.com/sports/nba/miami-heat/article309331020.html |website=Miami Herald |access-date=5 July 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250626181617/https://www.miamiherald.com/sports/nba/miami-heat/article309331020.html |archive-date=26 June 2025 |date=25 June 2025}}</ref> On 1 July, the Heat signed Jakučionis to a reported four-year, $17.7 million contract.<ref>{{cite web |title=Heat sign Kasparas Jakučionis |url=https://www.nba.com/heat/news/heat-sign-kasparas-jakucionis |website=NBA.com |access-date=5 July 2025 |date=1 July 2025}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last=Winderman |first=Ira |title=Heat sign first-round pick Kasparas Jakucionis to four-year, $17.7 million contract |url=https://www.sun-sentinel.com/2025/07/01/heat-sign-first-round-pick-kasparas-jakucionis-to-four-year-17-3-million-contract/ |website=Sun Sentinel |access-date=5 July 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250705060048/https://www.sun-sentinel.com/2025/07/01/heat-sign-first-round-pick-kasparas-jakucionis-to-four-year-17-3-million-contract/ |archive-date=5 July 2025 |date=1 July 2025}}</ref> He represented the Heat in the [[2025 NBA Summer League]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Heat announce Summer League information |url=https://www.nba.com/heat/news/heat-announce-summer-league-information-14 |website=NBA.com |date=29 June 2025}}</ref>

On 15 November, the Heat assigned Jakučionis to its [[NBA G League]] affiliate team, the [[Sioux Falls Skyforce]], for game action after recovering from injuries.<ref>{{cite web |title=Heat's Kasparas Jakucionis: Heads to G League |url=https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/heats-kasparas-jakucionis-heads-to-g-league/ |website=[[CBS Sports]] |access-date=19 November 2025 |date=17 November 2025}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last=Chiang |first=Anthony |title=Heat rookie Kasparas Jakucionis looking to make most of G League stint: 'He just needs to play' |url=https://www.miamiherald.com/sports/nba/miami-heat/article312974131.html |website=[[Miami Herald]] |access-date=19 November 2025 |date=19 November 2025}}</ref> On 16 November, Jakučionis debuted in the NBA G League by scoring 12 points, grabbing seven rebounds and dishing out two assists.<ref>{{cite web |title=Kasparas Jakučionis debiutavo NBA G lygoje |url=https://www.lrytas.lt/sportas/krepsinis/2025/11/17/news/kasparas-jakucionis-debiutavo-nba-g-lygoje-40292280 |website=[[Lrytas.lt]] |access-date=19 November 2025 |date=17 November 2025 |language=lt}}</ref>

On 1 December, Jakučionis made his NBA debut in a 140–123 win against the [[2025–26 Los Angeles Clippers season|Los Angeles Clippers]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Jakučionis debiutavo NBA lygoje, o Valančiūnas su komanda nesulaikė Daviso |url=https://www.lrt.lt/naujienos/sportas/10/2763026/jakucionis-debiutavo-nba-lygoje-o-valanciunas-su-komanda-nesulaike-daviso |website=[[Lithuanian National Radio and Television]] |language=lt |date=2 December 2025}}</ref> On 19 December, Jakučionis for the first time was a part of the Heat starting five due to injuries of [[Davion Mitchell]] and [[Tyler Herro]], and per 35 minutes he scored 17 points, grabbed six rebounds, dished out four assists, while the Heat won the game 129–116 against the [[2025–26 Boston Celtics season|Boston Celtics]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Heat's Kasparas Jakucionis: Scores 17 points in first NBA start |url=https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/heats-kasparas-jakucionis-scores-17-points-in-first-nba-start/ |website=[[CBS Sports]] |date=20 December 2025}}</ref> On 8 February 2026, Jakučionis scored a career-high 22 points and also had three rebounds, six assists, two steals and one block in a 132–101 victory over the [[2025–26 Washington Wizards season|Washington Wizards]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Coup’s Takeaways: HEAT Roll In Washington As Jakucionis, Ware Shine |url=https://www.nba.com/heat/news/coups-takeaways-heat-roll-in-washington-jakucionis-ware-shine-260208 |website=NBA.com|date=2026-02-08|access-date=2026-08-19|last=Moorhead|first=Couper}}</ref> The next day, on 9 February, Jakučionis demonstrated shooting consistency by once again making six three-point field goals (out of ten) and scored 20 points, along with three rebounds and one assist; however, this time the Heat lost the game 115–111 to the [[2025–26 Utah Jazz season|Utah Jazz]].<ref>{{cite web |last=Taylor |first=Cody |title='He's been big time': Kasparas Jakučionis is impressing for the Heat |url=https://sports.yahoo.com/articles/hes-big-time-kasparas-jakuc-194545360.html |website=Yahoo Sports |date=10 February 2026}}</ref> On 11 March 2026, Jakučionis began in a starting five and played 30 minutes in a [[Bam Adebayo's 83-point game|historic game]] between the Heat and the Washington Wizards during which his teammate [[Bam Adebayo]] scored 83 points, the second-highest [[List of NBA single-game scoring leaders|NBA single-game scoring performance]], and Jakučionis contributed to this achievement with his [[Assist (basketball)|assists]] to Adebayo.<ref>{{cite web |title=Beprotiška: Jakučionio komandos draugas suvertė 83 taškus viename mače |url=https://www.15min.lt/24sek/naujiena/nba/beprotiska-jakucionio-komandos-draugas-suverte-83-taskus-viename-mace-1130-2639092 |website=[[15min.lt]] |access-date=15 March 2026 |date=11 March 2026 |language=lt}}</ref> His debut season in the NBA ended when the Heat in the [[NBA play-in tournament#2026|2026 NBA play-in tournament]] lost the first game 127–126 after overtime to the [[2025–26 Charlotte Hornets season|Charlotte Hornets]] and failed to qualify for the [[2026 NBA playoffs]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Wild finish in Charlotte ends with Miami Heat eliminated |url=https://www.si.com/nba/heat/onsi/news/wild-finish-in-charlotte-ends-with-miami-heat-eliminated-01kp79en9kh0 |website=Sports Illustrated |access-date=21 May 2026 |date=15 April 2026|last=Hawk|first=Brady}}</ref>

===Milwaukee Bucks (2026–present)===
On 6 July 2026, Jakučionis, alongside [[Tyler Herro]], [[Kel'el Ware]], [[Jaime Jaquez Jr.]], the rights to [[Nate Ament]] and four future draft picks, was traded to the [[Milwaukee Bucks]] in exchange for [[Giannis Antetokounmpo]] and [[Bobby Portis]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Heat acquire Giannis Antetokounmpo in blockbuster deal |url=https://www.nba.com/news/reports-heat-acquire-giannis-antetokounmpo-in-blockbuster-deal |access-date=July 6, 2026 |website=NBA.com |date=6 July 2026}}</ref>

==Personal life==
Jakučionis is fluent in [[Lithuanian language|Lithuanian]], [[English language|English]] and [[Spanish language|Spanish]] languages.<ref>{{cite web |title=Sprendimą dėl rinktinės patvirtinęs K. Jakučionis – apie NBA lietuvius ir "Heat" kultūrą |url=https://www.lrytas.lt/sportas/krepsinis/2025/06/27/news/sprendima-del-rinktine-patvirtines-k-jakucionis-apie-nba-lietuvius-ir-heat-kultura-38471700 |website=lrytas.lt |access-date=29 June 2025 |language=lt |date=27 June 2025}}</ref> According to Jakučionis, his childhood hero in the NBA was [[LeBron James]] and his play is most influenced by [[Šarūnas Jasikevičius]].<ref>{{cite web |title=K. Jakučionis atskleidė savo krepšinio Dievus – išskyrė JAV ir Lietuvos legendas |url=https://www.lrytas.lt/sportas/krepsinis/2025/07/19/news/k-jakucionis-atskleide-savo-krepsinio-dievus-isskyre-jav-ir-lietuvos-legendas-38723745 |website=lrytas.lt |access-date=19 July 2025 |language=lt}}</ref>
